papers.title_en: HyScale: Scaling Long-Context Training for Learned Sparse Attention
papers.authors: Yangsheng Deng, Xinjing Huang, Yulong Wang, Yunzhuo Liu, Jun Hu, Shuyong Tang, Junchi Zeng, Mingji Han, Ray Ying, Key Zhang, Luo Mai
papers.evidence: 兼顾内存与计算优化的长上下文训练系统
papers.tldr: 面向百万级上下文的学习式稀疏注意力，候选选择需为每个查询打分全部历史令牌，成为训练瓶颈；现有系统还会物化完整分数表，并在重计算时重复选择。HyScale以“选择结果是索引而非激活”为核心，提出无分数表精确Top-k的HyTopK与前向选择回放，并配合端到端优化。在512张H20上，GLM-5.1的百万令牌训练较Megatron-LM快2.07倍，证明其可有效扩展长上下文稀疏注意力训练。
papers.abstract_en: We present HyScale, a long-context training system for learned sparse attention. Learned sparse attention is a promising architecture for million-token contexts, widely adopted in production since DeepSeek-V3.2. Selection, however, grows into the training bottleneck. For each query, it scores every previous token whereas sparse attention reads only $k$; worse, current systems materialize a full score table and repeat selection during recomputation. Our key insight is that the output of selection is not an activation, but rather a set of indices. Building on it, HyScale introduces HyTopK and selection replay. HyTopK finds each query's exact top-$k$ on the fly without a score table, while selection replay reuses forward-pass selection in recomputation. Together with holistic system optimizations tackling end-to-end training challenges, HyScale speeds up GLM-5.1 training on 1M-token sequences by 2.07$\times$ over Megatron-LM on 512 H20 GPUs. It also speeds up the CSA layers of DeepSeek-V4-Flash and the QSA layers of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next by 2.01$\times$ and 1.57$\times$ at 1M tokens on 32 H800 GPUs.

papers.title_en: Democratizing LLM Training with the Edge: Challenges, Systems, and the Road Ahead
papers.authors: Ziyue Luo, Jiaxuan Cai, Cedric LeDenmat, Srijith Nair, Fatemeh Nourzad, Rohith Krishnan, Qinhang Wu, Jifan Zhang, Sungjae Lee, Zhe Li, Peiwen Qiu, Siddharth Shah, Rishabh Sharma, Sundararajan Srinivasan, Yinglun Xia, Xue Zheng, Zidong Liu, Bicheng Ying, Kaushik Chowdhury, Gauri Joshi, Yingbin Liang, Robert Nowak, Srinivasan Parthasarathy, Saurav Prakash, Balaraman Ravindran, Sanjay Shakkottai, Ness B. Shroff, Haibo Yang, Aylin Yener, Jia Liu
papers.evidence: 面向地理分布式大模型训练系统的综述与路线图
papers.tldr: 大语言模型训练日益依赖集中式数据中心，拥有私有数据但算力有限的机构难以参与，且跨地域异构资源的协同训练尚不成熟。论文系统梳理联邦、切分与去中心化训练在预训练和微调中的适用性，并提出统一架构。该架构以云端参数服务器和出站gRPC连接协调异构客户端，复用通信、压缩与容错栈。在多所高校真实环境中，GPT-2 Medium与Llama3-1B预训练稳定收敛，为普惠化训练指出系统与算法协同方向。
papers.abstract_en: The growing computational power of modern GPU data centers has let a few industrial giants train and deploy large language models (LLMs) on massive amounts of data. Yet the sheer scale of these models and their training data makes centralized development increasingly hard to sustain, and at the same time shuts out smaller institutions that hold relevant private data but lack comparable infrastructure. In this paper, we organize our positions on distributed LLM training around the pretraining and fine-tuning paradigms, covering federated learning, split learning, and decentralized approaches, and we assess their readiness for geo-distributed settings with heterogeneous hardware and unreliable connectivity. We then present a {\em unified} system architecture built around a cloud-hosted parameter server that coordinates heterogeneous clients over outbound gRPC connections, reusing one communication, compression, and fault-tolerance stack for both pretraining and a family of fine-tuning methods. We validate the design with real geo-distributed experiments on GPT-2 Medium and Llama3-1B pretraining across multiple university sites, showing stable convergence under realistic conditions. Finally, we chart the road ahead, identifying open problems that span frontier model support, elastic fault tolerance, adaptive compression, federated alignment, privacy and trust, incentive design, and system--algorithm co-design, all of which must be addressed to make democratized LLM training a reality.

papers.title_en: InferSlice: A Reference Architecture for SLO-driven LLM Inference over a Telco Wide-Area Network
papers.authors: Juan Parra-Ullauri, Anthony Chiu, Hari Madhukumar, Zhaozhou Wu, Anderson Bravalheri, Alex Healing, Andy Corston-Petrie, Dimitra Simeonidou, Nektaria Efthymiou
papers.evidence: 集成GPU划分的服务等级目标驱动大模型推理架构
papers.tldr: 企业级交互式大模型推理受数据主权、合规、时延与资源属地约束，集中云部署难以满足电信广域网场景。InferSlice提出面向服务等级目标的参考架构，联合网络切片、GPU分区、弹性服务与可观测性，在英国全国级JOINER网络验证。实验揭示不同服务层级的时延—吞吐区间，并量化跨站并行边界：流水线并行可跨近中距离站点，而张量并行和预填充—解码拆分仅适于单子网跳。该工作为运营商部署异构、分布式大模型推理提供了工程经验与设计依据。
papers.abstract_en: LLM inference is increasingly deployed as a core service for enterprise and interactive applications, but sovereignty, compliance, latency and resource-locality requirements can limit the suitability of centralised cloud deployments. Telco operators offer geographically distributed compute and network infrastructure for addressing these constraints. However, existing LLM serving frameworks are designed for tightly coupled data centres and provide limited support for coordinating geographically distributed and heterogeneous resources. We present InferSlice, a reference architecture for Service-Level Objective (SLO)-driven LLM inference over a telco infrastructure, integrating network slicing, GPU partitioning, elastic serving and observability. Led by BT in collaboration with the University of Bristol and NVIDIA, and realised on the JOINER UK national-scale wide-area network (WAN), InferSlice is evaluated on service differentiation across tiers, elastic scale-out, client-edge bandwidth as a bottleneck, and the reach of tensor, pipeline, data parallelism, and prefill/decode disaggregation over the WAN. Our results show that, on a general-purpose telco network, tiers yield distinct latency-throughput regimes, and weight streaming shortens scale-out time. Replication is placement-insensitive but memory-bound; pipeline parallelism tolerates near- and mid-cross-site hops, while tensor parallelism and disaggregation fail beyond a single subnet hop. We share practical insights from operating SLO-driven inference on a telco network, lessons learned and open questions, and hope to encourage further research on distributed and heterogeneous LLM inference systems.

papers.title_en: Sustainable Processing-in-DRAM Integration and Replacement for Transformer Inference Servers
papers.evidence: 面向Transformer推理服务器的架构与生命周期优化
papers.tldr: 面向Transformer推理服务器，PID通过将计算下沉至DRAM缓解带宽瓶颈，但其全生命周期碳收益及更换策略尚缺系统评估。论文构建覆盖制造、空闲与运行阶段的碳模型，并加入10年期老化感知替换优化。评估3类GPU、6种PID与8个工作负载后发现，PID最多仅使隐含碳增加2.5%，总碳最高可降至编码器1.14倍、解码器1.04倍。研究揭示PID收益强依赖所配GPU，为低碳推理服务器配置和更新决策提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Processing-in-DRAM (PID) accelerators are emerging as a sustainable alternative to GPUs for transformer model inference. They bring compute to data, mitigate the memory bandwidth limitation, and reduce the overall energy footprint. Yet, carbon analysis of PID accelerators is covered for only a limited set of hardware and workloads. In this work, we present a carbon modeling framework for PID-enabled inference servers that captures embodied carbon along with idle and active operational carbon. Our evaluation spans three GPU baselines, six PID architectures, and eight transformer workloads. Additionally, we propose an aging-aware model that finds the carbon-optimal replacement period for PID accelerators over a 10-year horizon. Across evaluated configurations, our analysis shows that including PIDs in AI inference servers increases the total embodied carbon by at most 2.5\%, while the total carbon is reduced by up to 1.14$\times$ for encoder and 1.04$\times$ for decoder transformer workloads. The results also depend on GPU selection for pairing, where introducing PID modules in high-end HGX-H100 servers incurs 5.4--5.9$\times$ higher total carbon compared to A100 and H100 servers, due to their larger idle and embodied carbon. Introducing PID modules in higher-end GPU servers, compared to the A100-only baseline, increases (decreases) the total carbon-delay product (CDP) for encoder workloads (decoder workloads).

papers.title_en: NousDB - A Fast Query Engine for Semantic Analytics
papers.authors: Christos Tsapelas, Georgia Koutrika, Yannis Ioannidis
papers.evidence: 可扩展的人工智能语义分析引擎
papers.tldr: 语义数据分析把大模型等AI算子嵌入查询流程，但逐元组调用、临时算子设计和缺少成本模型使系统难以扩展与优化。NousDB基于Apache DataFusion扩展关系代数，引入三类语义算子及可用于重写和跨算子优化的形式化性质。系统再以等深度令牌直方图构建令牌成本模型，在上下文窗口约束下安全选择批量大小。实验显示，其在本地及企业级大模型上最高提速86倍，并在令牌效率和准确性上领先，令传统与语义混合分析均可高效执行。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic data analytics systems integrate AI-powered operators into query pipelines, enabling declarative queries over structured and unstructured data. However, existing systems rely on per-tuple model invocations, ad hoc operator designs, and lack principled cost models, resulting in poor scalability and limited optimization. We present NousDB, a high-performance semantic analytics engine built on Apache DataFusion[22]. Through NousDB we propose an extended relational algebra with three semantic operators and formal algebraic properties that enable principled query rewriting and cross-operator optimization. We further propose a token-based cost model using equi-depth token histograms to optimize batch sizing under context-window constraints and provide statistical guarantees for safe batching. Experiments show that NousDB achieves up to x86 speedups with both local and enterprise LLMs, while leading competitors in token efficiency and accuracy. These gains extend to complex JOB and Stack workloads augmented with semantic operators, supporting both traditional and semantic analytics.

papers.title_en: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
papers.evidence: 低精度大模型嵌入内存优化
papers.tldr: 许多开源语言模型借助n-gram嵌入表存储相邻词元组合表示以提升性能，但该类表的参数量和显存开销极大。论文提出将嵌入表低比特量化，并系统比较量化方法与不同表的比特分配。在从头训练模型中，4比特表节省约75%表内存，同时保留超过99%的验证损失改进；在现有大模型中可节省47%至55%内存且困惑度增幅不足1.2%。研究表明，低比特n-gram表是降低记忆成本、并可将节省容量再投入以提升性能的实用途径。
papers.abstract_en: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.

papers.title_en: KVStream: Adaptive Parallel Storage Management for KV Caching in Large-Scale LLM Serving
papers.authors: Avinash Maurya, Jaiaid Mobin, Jie Ye, M. Mustafa Rafique, Franck Cappello, Bogdan Nicolae
papers.evidence: 大规模大模型服务的并行存储调度
papers.tldr: 长上下文大模型服务中，复用前缀的键值缓存常超出显存与主存，读取被单节点本地固态盘串行承担，成为首词延迟瓶颈。KVStream将前缀读取建模为跨本地盘、并行文件系统和云存储的聚合带宽调度，按块全层复制并让空闲层动态领取未读块。它无需预测或手工调参即可逼近带宽上界，并通过前向计算期间延后写入减少读写干扰。在128张GPU实验中，其离线吞吐最高提升1.49倍、突发请求平均首词延迟最高降低6.1倍，证明多层存储可有效扩展缓存服务能力。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM serving for agentic, coding, and document workloads reuses prefixes whose key-value (KV) cache outgrows GPU and host memory, putting storage I/O on the critical path of the inference step for retrieving prefixes. A single node-local NVMe absorbs all retrievals, while the parallel file system or cloud file store that nodes already mount carries almost no inference traffic. We cast prefix retrieval as aggregate-bandwidth scheduling across these tiers and present KVStream, a KV cache engine that batches a step's reads, defers writes behind the forward pass, replicates each chunk on every tier, and lets each tier adaptively claim the next unread chunks once it is free. Our performance model shows this routing attains the aggregate-bandwidth bound without prediction or tuning, whereas any static split misses it by a margin that grows as per-tier bandwidths drift or fluctuate. It also predicts that the time-to-first-token (TTFT) gain grows with load, as faster retrieval drains the queue, and disappears when host memory or arrival order keeps reuse in cache. Plugged into LMCache and evaluated on four models, six datasets, and up to 128 GPUs, KVStream retrieves within 5% of the bound, delivers up to 1.49$\times$ higher offline throughput than LMCache, and lowers mean TTFT by up to 6.1$\times$ under bursty arrivals.

papers.title_en: RAFT: Redundancy-Aware Input Filtering for Temporal Graph Neural Network Training
papers.authors: Yue Dai, Sarah Zhou, Youtao Zhang
papers.evidence: 输入过滤缓解可扩展图训练的依赖瓶颈
papers.tldr: 时序图神经网络训练需按事件持续更新节点记忆，事件依赖限制并行，数据增长又放大计算开销。RAFT依据训练中节点记忆变化识别冗余，分别过滤预测目标根事件和采样历史支持事件。在3种模型、5个数据集上，平均减少35.23%训练输入，最高97.11%，训练时间最高降52.56%，精度几乎不变。该方法在下游处理前削减无效工作，为可扩展TGNN训练提供通用输入层优化。
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) have shown strong performance on dynamic graph learning tasks by continuously updating node memories from evolving interactions (i.e., events) and leveraging these memories for downstream predictions. As graphs grow rapidly in modern applications, training requires processing an increasing number of events; meanwhile, each event can update node memories used by later events, creating dependencies that constrain parallel execution and limit the benefits of additional computing resources. These costs motivate an upstream question: Are all events, and the dependencies they introduce, necessary for learning? We investigate this question through two roles of temporal events: prediction targets and historical events sampled as inputs. We observe that targets involving stable node memories tend to exhibit lower prediction loss, while filtering historical events associated with stable memories can retain similar training-loss trajectories in several evaluated settings. Together, these observations suggest an opportunity to identify input redundancy through changes in node memories. Building on this opportunity, we propose RAFT, a redundancy-aware input-filtering framework for TGNN training. RAFT tracks memory changes during training and uses them to guide two filters: a root-event filter removes selected prediction targets before training, and a support-event filter excludes selected historical context during sampling. Filtering inputs before their downstream preparation and processing reduces the work they trigger. Across three TGNN models and five datasets, RAFT reduces training inputs by 35.23% on average and up to 97.11%, while reducing recorded training time by up to 52.56\% with negligible changes to model precisions.

papers.title_en: Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs
papers.authors: Abhinav Khattar, Aishwarya Chhabra, Ameya Velingker, Anusha Kamath, Brandon Norick, Kanishk Singla, Kiran Praveen, Markus Kliegl, Mohammad Qazim Bhat, Mostofa Patwary, Niket Agarwal, Rajpreet Thethy, Ramani Akkati, Raviraj Joshi, Sai Nishanth Padala, Shuoyang Ding, Sriharsha Niverty, Utkarsh Vaidya, Vitaly Lavrukhin, Yev Meyer, Anoop Kunchukuttan, Mitesh Khapra, Mohammed Safi Ur Rahman Khan, Rudra Murthy, Sumanth Doddapaneni, Thanmay Jayakumar, Ujjwal Sharma
papers.evidence: GPU加速数据流水线支撑大规模语言模型预训练
papers.tldr: 印度语言大模型受限于高质量多语种训练数据与统一评测不足。论文发布Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1，覆盖22种原生文字语言及12种罗马化形式，规模约2.83万亿词元，并以翻译、质检和修复流水线构建。持续预训练显示其与自然语料结合可提升知识和推理能力；同时提出覆盖多类能力的评测套件，为Indic模型研发提供开放数据与评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: Building capable language models for India requires scalable multilingual data and robust evaluation. We introduce Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1, a synthetic pretraining corpus of approximately 2.83 trillion tokens covering all 22 scheduled Indian languages in native script and twelve in romanized form. It is the largest openly released Indic pretraining corpus. Using our GPU-accelerated pipeline, we translate curated English documents, assess translation quality, and repair low-quality outputs while preserving technical content and document structure and maintaining source traceability. Through continued-pretraining experiments across twelve languages, we show that combining our synthetic corpus with natural Indic text improves knowledge and reasoning over a public-corpus baseline. Additional experiments show how data volume, script coverage, and Indic training share affect English performance. We also introduce the Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite, a multilingual benchmark suite for evaluating Indic language models across chat, instruction following, reasoning, knowledge, code, and translation. The suite combines existing Indic benchmarks with task-aware translations of English benchmarks, using automated quality assessment, targeted correction, and native-speaker review in a human-in-the-loop pipeline. We use the suite to comprehensively benchmark contemporary open-weight Indic and multilingual models across capabilities and languages, revealing substantial variation across tasks and languages. Together, these resources provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating more capable Indic language models.

papers.title_en: Learning-Theoretic Foundation for General Coded Computing: The Adversarial Setting
papers.authors: Parsa Moradi, Hanzaleh Akbarinodehi, Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali
papers.evidence: 面向对抗节点的编码分布式计算
papers.tldr: 分布式计算中的对抗节点会返回篡改结果，传统编码计算常需先定位、纠正或剔除错误，导致主节点开销较高且缺少随节点规模变化的误差刻画。论文将通用编码计算扩展到对抗场景，通过端到端误差上界学习编码器和解码器，并以平滑正则抑制恶意输出影响而非逐一识别。基于平滑样条可实现主节点线性复杂度，并给出编码误差、诚实重建误差和对抗扰动误差的非渐近分解。当N个节点中至多q个对抗时，适当调参可达O((q/N)^(6/5))最坏误差；若q次线性增长，误差渐近消失。
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial workers pose a severe challenge in distributed computing systems by returning corrupted outputs that can substantially distort the recovered computations. Coded computing addresses this threat by introducing redundancy across worker assignments. Existing exact and approximate coded-computing methods typically handle adversarial outputs by explicitly locating and correcting or removing erroneous evaluations, which adds significant computational overhead at the master node. Moreover, existing analyses do not characterize how the recovery error scales with the number of workers and the adversarial budget.   In this paper, we develop an adversarially robust extension of general coded computing (GCC), a learning-theoretic approximate coded-computing framework that designs the encoder and decoder by minimizing an upper bound on the end-to-end recovery error. Rather than identifying corrupted workers, the proposed method uses smoothness regularization to limit the influence of their outputs. The resulting encoder and decoder can be implemented using smoothing splines with linear master-side complexity. We derive a non-asymptotic bound on the worst-case end-to-end approximation error by decomposing it into three components: (1) the encoder approximation error, (2) the decoder reconstruction error under fully honest results, and (3) the adversarial perturbation error. For maximum of $q\geq 1$ adversarial workers among $N$ workers results in a worst-case error of order $\mathcal{O}((q/N)^{6/5})$ with appropriate selection of smoothness parameter, demonstrating that the approximation error vanishes asymptotically whenever the number of adversaries grows sublinearly with the network size. Experiments on scalar computation and neural-network inference are consistent with the predicted convergence behavior.

papers.title_en: Privacy-Preserving Personalized Federated Learning (PPP-FL) for Medical Imaging
papers.authors: Md Morshedul Islam, Hossain Shahriar, Alfredo Cuzzocrea
papers.evidence: 面向联邦分布式训练的隐私分析与个性化方法
papers.tldr: 联邦学习虽不传输原始医疗数据，却仍可能遭受模型反演，且差分隐私会带来性能下降。本文以脑MRI为场景，提出基于DCGAN的现实条件模型反演攻击，并结合客户端差分隐私与个性化联邦学习开展攻防评估。实验显示攻击可重建具语义意义的合成图像；差分隐私有效抑制泄露，而个性化训练可弥补精度损失。研究还揭示聚合算法会同时影响攻击风险与防御效果，为医疗联邦学习的隐私设计提供通用框架。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning paradigm that reduces transmission costs, mitigates cross-border data sharing restrictions, and enhances privacy by keeping raw data on local devices. Clients in FL systems train local models and share only updates, which are aggregated by a central server. While this setup limits direct data exposure, FL remains vulnerable to privacy attacks. Existing attack and defense strategies have largely been developed for centralized systems, and adapting them to FL introduces new challenges due to its unique architecture and training workflow. In this work, we first propose a model inversion attack on FL systems using Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGANs) in the context of large-scale medical imaging. Our method operates under realistic assumptions about the attacker's knowledge and capabilities. We then examine the effect of client-side differential privacy (DP) in mitigating privacy leakage and incorporate personalized FL to improve model performance under DP settings. Experiments on the Brain MRI ND-5 dataset show that DCGAN-based attacks can reconstruct semantically meaningful synthetic images, revealing significant risks to the privacy of training data. Applying DP reduces attack success but introduces an accuracy trade-off, which is further overcome by personalized FL at each client side. We also evaluate how different aggregation algorithms affect both attack vulnerability and defense effectiveness, underscoring the critical role of aggregation strategies. The proposed attack-and-defense framework is model-agnostic and applicable to a wide range of FL-based systems.

papers.title_en: Target Regeneration Shrinks the Gains of Draft-Training Objectives in Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Jungseob Lee, Hogun Seong, Euijun Choi, Sugyeong Eo
papers.evidence: 评估用于加速大模型推理的推测解码训练目标
papers.tldr: 推测解码常以外部回答训练草稿模型，并将蒸馏或验证门控带来的接受率提升归因于新目标；但实际流水线中目标模型常会先重写这些回答。论文在视觉语言目标模型与块式草稿模型上，对比语料交叉熵、目标蒸馏和仅保留可验证位置的门控蒸馏，并引入贪婪再生成基线。结果显示，再生成后蒸馏增益明显缩小，门控增益几乎消失；该现象跨设置、数据集及文本模型复现，提示评测必须采用目标再生成基线并比较训练长度。
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models by verifying drafted tokens in parallel. New draft-training objectives are usually credited with the acceptance they add over cross-entropy on externally written responses, yet many pipelines let the target rewrite them. We ask how much of that gain survives. With a vision-language target and a block drafter, we train three objectives on four versions of one corpus: cross-entropy on corpus tokens, token-level distillation from the target, and distillation gated to positions that would survive verification. Distillation and the gate add large gains on external responses, but after greedy regeneration, distillation adds a smaller gain and the gate little or none. The shrinkage persists across data orders, position weights, verifiers, decoding temperatures and, for distillation, initializations and learning rates. Most of it remains at matched supervised length and at each objective's best measured training length. A second vision corpus shows the shrinkage, as does a text-only replication, for distillation also with an autoregressive drafter. Objective gains should therefore be measured against a target-regenerated baseline and across training lengths. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRegeneration.

papers.title_en: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏专家模型的推理内存优化
papers.tldr: 稀疏MoE模型虽能以少量激活参数扩展容量，但长上下文推理的KV缓存仍随序列长度线性膨胀。现有压缩方法主要面向稠密模型，忽略缓存淘汰会扰动MoE专家路由、进而损害生成质量的问题。MoEZip以路由分布的Fisher信息度量路由敏感性，并结合注意力权重进行上下文保留评分，再融合稠密与MoE场景的互补淘汰策略。在仅保留10% KV缓存时，它在LongBench和RULER上显著超过现有最佳方法，为MoE长上下文部署提供路由感知的高效压缩方案。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. We propose MoEZip, a routing-aware KV cache compression for sparse MoE language models. To estimate the sensitivity of expert routing to perturbation, we propose a novel metric based on the Fisher information matrix of routing distributions. MoEZip combines this metric with attention weights for routing-aware scoring of contexts. Finally, we compose a complementary scoring system that combines eviction methods for dense and sparse-MoE architectures. Experiments show that MoEZip achieves robust performance under aggressive cache compression on various benchmarks. At a KV retention ratio of 10\%, MoEZip improves over the SoTA baseline by +24 and +20 points on average on LongBench and RULER, corresponding to 2.3$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ higher scores, respectively.

papers.title_en: FedBST: Bilateral Self-Training for Unsupervised Federated Classification
papers.authors: Aijing Yu, Kuangpu Guo, Jian Liang, Xiao-Yu Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向非独立同分布无标签分类的联邦训练框架
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型支持无标签联邦分类，但严重非独立同分布会削弱现有仅选高置信伪标签的自训练，遗漏大量模糊“腰部”样本并造成决策边界偏置。FedBST提出双边自训练：训练时以不确定性感知置信度惩罚抑制模糊样本的过度自信，推理时融合本地视觉原型与文本原型。实验显示其在标准联邦聚合协议下稳定优于已有方法，并提升了无标签数据利用与本地分布适应能力。
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised federated learning with Vision-Language Models (e.g., CLIP) offers a promising solution for label-free classification, yet its performance often degrades under severe non-IID shifts. A pioneering method, FedCoPL, typically relies on self-training strategies that exclusively prioritize high-confidence predictions for pseudo-labeling. However, this selective approach neglects the information of ambiguous samples (often referred to as ``waist" samples), leading to the underutilization of data and biased decision boundaries. To address this limitation, we propose FedBST, a bilateral self-training framework that effectively exploits both high-confidence and ambiguous data. Specifically, for local optimization, we introduce uncertainty-aware confidence penalization (UACP). UACP targets ambiguous samples by penalizing overconfident predictions to implicitly promote higher uncertainty, thereby preventing erroneous pseudo-labeling. At inference, we employ a visual-text ensemble strategy. This approach aggregates uncertainty-aware local visual prototypes and ensembles them with textual prototypes, achieving lightweight adaptation to local distributions via prototype-based calibration. Experiments demonstrate that FedBST achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with standard federated aggregation protocols.

papers.title_en: Fine-Grained Units, Flat Decisions: Hierarchical Micro-Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.authors: Zukang Xu, Xinpei Gao, Xing Hu, Zhe Jiang, Dawei Yang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型部署的MoE容量与计算优化
papers.tldr: 微专家剪枝虽能细化MoE容量压缩，但仅以语言模型困惑度评估会掩盖下游任务能力差异。论文将掩码构建拆分为专家间容量分配与专家内通道选择两项决策，提出两阶段后训练框架UC-RAMP。其先依据跨域校准证据重分配专家宽度，再以通道交互代理进行替换优化。在三种模型、六组设置中取得五组最高十任务均分，并在50%剪枝时显著领先基线，同时带来实际推理延迟下降。
papers.abstract_en: Micro-expert pruning reduces the capacity of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models by removing coupled channels within routed experts. However, finer pruning granularity alone does not guarantee the preservation of downstream capabilities, as similar language-modeling perplexity can accompany substantially different task performance. We revisit micro-expert mask construction as two distinct decisions: allocating retained capacity across experts and selecting channels within that capacity. We propose UC-RAMP, a two-stage post-training pruning framework that explicitly separates these decisions. CAPE uses cross-domain calibration evidence to redistribute expert widths under an exact layer-wise budget, while RAMP refines channel composition at fixed widths through one-out, one-in exchanges guided by a channel-interaction surrogate. Across three MoE models at 25% and 50% routed-expert channel pruning, UC-RAMP achieves the highest ten-task mean accuracy among evaluated pruning methods in five of six settings. At 50% pruning, it outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 8.19, 3.96, and 6.14 percentage points across the three models, respectively. In a single-A100 deployment at 25% pruning, UC-RAMP reduces measured time to first token by 19.7--23.9% and time per output token by 20.2--22.3% relative to the unpruned model. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/UC_RAMP.

papers.title_en: Beyond Finite-Sum Optimization: A Primal-Dual Method for Decentralized Finite-Max Optimization
papers.authors: Zhouxing Luo, Lei Wang, Xin Liu
papers.evidence: 去中心化梯度跟踪优化方法
papers.tldr: 去中心化系统常以最差节点表现为评价标准，但现有方法多面向平均型有限和目标。本文研究连通无向网络上的光滑非凸有限最大化，借助二次正则将其改写为带标量对偶变量的平滑有限和问题。提出交替原始—对偶梯度跟踪方法，仅依赖邻居通信和局部截断权重，无需全局投影。理论证明原始迭代有界、网络平均的聚点满足Clarke驻点性，并在O(ε^-3)轮内得到ε-驻点；实验显示其可改善最差节点性能。
papers.abstract_en: Many decentralized systems are judged by their worst-performing agents rather than their average performance. We study finite-max optimization over a connected undirected network, where each agent knows only its own smooth, possibly nonconvex objective. Quadratic regularization yields a smooth finite-sum representation with a scalar dual variable and locally computable clipped weights. We develop an alternating primal-dual gradient tracking (APDGT) method, using neighbor communication without any global or centralized projections. Under smoothness and level-boundedness assumptions, a localized Lyapunov analysis with vanishing regularization establishes bounded primal iterates and Clarke stationarity of every accumulation point of their network average. The averaged sequence contains an $\varepsilon$-stationary point, measured by near-active gradients, within $O (\varepsilon^{-3})$ iterations. Synthetic tests and decentralized logistic regression on Fashion-MNIST illustrate convergence behavior and potential improvements in worst-agent performance.

papers.title_en: Reconstruction-Optimized Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.authors: Jelena Markovic-Voronov, Petros Prastakos, Kayhan Behdin, Jincheng Cao, Zhipeng Wang, Shayan Mohajer Hamidi, Yuanda Xu, Zhengze Zhou, Wenhui Zhu, Rahul Mazumder
papers.evidence: 可扩展MoE剪枝支持大模型高效部署
papers.tldr: MoE虽通过稀疏激活降低推理计算，但部署时仍需存储大量专家参数，后训练专家裁剪尤为关键。论文将裁剪建模为基于任务域校准数据、最大化重构原层输出的固定规模子集选择问题。OptEP以可微连续松弛直接优化专家选择变量，并对保留专家进行轻量重构式权重更新。在多种模型及数学、代码任务上，其在激进裁剪下显著优于现有方法，最高带来16.20个百分点绝对准确率提升。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse expert activation, but deployment still requires storing a large number of expert parameters. We study post-training expert pruning using task-domain calibration data as a subset-selection problem: given a pretrained MoE layer, select a fixed number of experts that best reconstruct its original output. Exact subset search is combinatorial and becomes intractable for modern MoE models with many experts per layer. We develop OptEP, a scalable continuous relaxation that directly optimizes differentiable expert-selection variables, followed by a lightweight reconstruction-based update of the retained expert weights. Across multiple MoE architectures and tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approach improves over the strongest existing expert-pruning baselines, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 15.05% on Qwen3-30B-A3B, 14.55% on Qwen3-235B-A22B, 11.06% on GLM-4.5-Air, and 16.20% on Mixtral-8x7B. The improvements are particularly pronounced under aggressive pruning, demonstrating that reconstruction-driven expert selection and weight adaptation can preserve substantially more of the original model's performance while reducing the number of retained experts.
